{{Short description|Norwegian mathematician and meteorologist}}
{{Use dmy dates | date=November 2024}}
'''Carl Ludvig Schreiner Godske''' (20 May 1906 &ndash; 3 July 1970) was a Norwegian mathematician and meteorologist. He was born in [[Bindal Municipality]]. He was a member of the [[Bergen School of Meteorology]], working as meteorologist in [[Bergen (city)|Bergen]] from 1938, and appointed professor at the [[University of Bergen]] from 1946. Among his publications is ''Dynamic Meteorology and Weather Forecasting'' from 1957. He was also a pioneer in the application of electronic computers in Norway. He chaired the [[Norwegian Geophysical Society]] from 1956 to 1957 and was a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] from 1937. He was decorated Knight, First Class of the [[Order of St. Olav]] in 1967.<ref name=nbl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=C L Godske |encyclopedia=[[Norsk biografisk leksikon]]|first=Kåre |last=Utaaker |authorlink= |editor=[[Knut Helle|Helle, Knut]]|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget |location=Oslo |url=http://nbl.snl.no/C_L_Godske|language=Norwegian |accessdate=12 June 2014}}</ref><ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=Carl Ludvig Schreiner Godske |first= |last= |encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |editor-last=Godal | editor-first=Anne Marit | editor-link=Anne Marit Godal |publisher=Norsk nettleksikon |location=Oslo |url=http://snl.no/Carl_Ludvig_Schreiner_Godske |language=Norwegian |accessdate=12 June 2014}}</ref>
